entries.text: Subscription update failures are now visible: the profile card shows a red badge with the error detail instead of failing silently in the background
An empty proxies page after a failed group fetch now shows an error message instead of a silent blank screen

New updateProxyNode kernel method: edit a node in place; the name is kept as the anchor for groups, rules and chains, the entry is replaced as a whole and identity collisions with other nodes are rejected
Nodes can be edited from the manage-nodes sheet: the form is prefilled with the node parameters, protocol and name are locked while editing
Proxy favorites: mark nodes from the card context menu and they are pinned to the top of every proxy list (per profile)
Scheduled auto exit test: once a day the app re-tests nodes without fresh landing records; can be turned off in the proxies settings
Tray menu now supports switching nodes per group on Windows (previously macOS only), capped at 60 entries per group with the current selection pinned
The add-proxy-chain sheet gains a target profile picker so exit nodes can be chosen from any profile, not only the currently selected one
Share links that carry no name fragment are auto-named (host:port) instead of failing with a missing-name error
Adding the same node twice through different entry points (share link vs exported config) is now rejected by identity - type, server, port and credentials - not by name

New removeProxyNodes kernel method: deleting a node also cleans up group members, routing rules and listeners referencing it; emptied groups fall back to DIRECT and the match-all rule falls back to DIRECT
Nodes can now be deleted from the app: a context menu on every proxy card (right click / long press: delay test, exit test, delete) and a manage-nodes sheet with per-node and batch deletion

Newly added nodes now show up and are selectable: nodes added to a profile that already had the default groups were stored but orphaned (in no proxy group, invisible on the proxies page, unreachable by rules). They are now attached to the default groups on every addition, and clicking update re-attaches any previously orphaned nodes; custom-named groups are never touched

Pasting a full V2rayN/Xray config containing Hysteria2 now works: the converter maps protocol "hysteria" (version 2) to mihomo hysteria2 (auth -> password, serverName -> sni, tls) and drops mihomo-incompatible keys (network/mux/finalmask); share links were never affected

The update button now works for custom (file-based) profiles: it re-applies the local file through the converter and validator instead of doing nothing; subscription profiles keep pulling from the remote, and the menu entry is visible for every profile

Smart anti-detection layer: auto-fill client-side TLS fingerprint and ALPN for vmess/vless/trojan when absent (all import sources, explicit values never overridden); failed delay tests rotate the fingerprint through a pool (chrome/firefox/safari/ios/edge/qq/randomized/chrome120) with cooldown and pool-exhausted stop; toggle in Settings > Network, on by default

Manual node form: add ALPN for vmess/vless/trojan/hysteria2, trojan Reality (public key / short-id / fingerprint), hysteria2 port hopping (ports / hop-interval), vless fingerprint selector for all TLS scenarios

Pasted nodes no longer collide on the generic outbound tag: tags like "proxy"/"outbound" are replaced by protocol-address-port (Xray JSON) or address:port (sing-box JSON) names; custom tags are preserved
Auto-convert pasted V2rayN/Xray-exported JSON and sing-box JSON into mihomo nodes (full config or single outbound), with stream/reality/tls mapping and non-node outbounds skipped
Add an add-node entry to profile card menus and let the add-node panel pick its target profile, defaulting to the profile it was opened from

Fix the manual node form: map the trojan/hysteria2 SNI field to the correct key, always honor the selected ws/grpc transport even without a path or service name, and require the obfs password when obfuscation is enabled
Add a manual node form (socks5/http/shadowsocks/vmess/vless/trojan/hysteria2) with per-protocol dynamic fields that reuses the existing add-proxy-node pipeline
Add a three-state dashboard connection hero, intent-based proxy grouping with matching custom rules, and a first-run best-preset guide
Open the chain-proxy target picker as a regular sheet so the chain-proxy pages stop rendering blank
Skip automatic batch exit tests on metered connections, move the proxy exit store into the drift database, and rebuild proxy consumers per node name
Probe every node's real exit region automatically after a delay test, keep the results on disk, and classify nodes by where they actually land instead of what they are named
Generate strategy groups per region and store them in the override data
Label every proxy card with its region and filter the list by region
Add the region engine: recognise a node's region from its name, bucket it, and plan region groups
Make the subscription update entry a labelled button, add a blank profile, and rework the dashboard
Rework the proxy page cards, make per-node delay testing visible, and add a connect button
Restrict group types to the ones this core supports, fix stored relay groups, and align the group cards
Add the bridge layer: new strings, a drag handle widget, core calls, and models
Give a blank profile default groups, add node import, and move proxy chaining to dialer-proxy
Default to overseas DoH upstreams, migrate existing profiles, and add a DNS leak self-check
Add one-step connect and align the takeover switch with the running state
Add the subscription compatibility layer and default strategy groups
Rebrand the fork as BiLoom
Move the protocol chip onto the second row so all three card types line up
Show every strategy group except the ones explicitly marked hidden
Add GPL attribution, fix the About wording, make update checks tri-state, repair TUN, and default fallback-filter.geoip to false
